title: How a FlexLine Limit Increase Is Figured
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — the way the increase is figured follows the current credit limit and its age: on a limit of 7500.00 USD or more, the tier's maximum increase percent applies to the first 5000.00 USD and half that percent applies to the rest; on a limit of 5000.00 USD or less on a line open 24 months or more, the percent applies only to the part of the limit above 1000.00 USD; on any other limit the percent applies to the whole limit.

The age is counted in whole calendar months from the open date to the decision date, a month counting only once the decision date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

| Current limit | Line open | Increase |
|---|---|---|
| 7500.00 or more | any | full percent on the first 5000.00, half the percent on the rest |
| 5000.00 or less | 24 whole calendar months or more | the percent on the part above 1000.00 |
| 5000.00 or less | fewer than 24 whole calendar months | the percent on the whole limit |
| above 5000.00, below 7500.00 | any | the percent on the whole limit |

## Hypothetical figures

- FlexLine Premier (40%), limit 12000.00: 40% of 5000.00 is 2000.00, plus 20% of 7000.00 is 1400.00, together 3400.00.
- FlexLine Standard (25%), limit 4500.00, line 30 months old: 25% of 3500.00 is 875.00.
- FlexLine Standard (25%), limit 4500.00, line 10 months old: 25% of 4500.00 is 1125.00.
- FlexLine Plus (30%), limit 6000.00: 30% of 6000.00 is 1800.00.
